item.title: One if Made This Rust Filter 4x Slower: The CPU Was Guessing for You
item.description: Filtering 1M floats: why is keeping half the slowest case? I reproduced the HN-top branch-prediction experiment on Windows (i5-12400F, rustc 1.97.1): a branchless rewrite cut the worst case from 5.1ms to 1.5ms (3.4x faster) — and learned when the trick backfires

item.title: PostgreSQL 18 Benchmark Data: I Said You Could Kill Your Redis Cache Layer. You Didn't Believe Me.
item.description: Real benchmark data for PostgreSQL 18: async IO + skip scan deliver a massive database performance leap. Production test with 1K concurrent users shows P95 latency dropping from 72ms to 54ms after removing Redis. Third-party benchmarks show 3.4x faster sequential scans.

item.title: Bun (Elysia) vs Rust (Actix) Performance Showdown: A Real-World Benchmark
item.description: Which is faster, Bun or Rust? This article uses a real-world URL shortener service benchmark to compare Bun (Elysia) and Rust (Actix) in throughput, latency, and developer experience, helping you choose the right tech stack.
